root_idea.summary: The root centers on gathering or bringing something together, especially what is extracted, collected, or brought to completion.
root_idea.development: From the idea of gathering, the root develops usages for extracting a product, making hidden contents apparent, collecting results, and denoting what remains or results from an action. Related specialized usages include the bird's crop and collected agricultural produce.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form II active perfect citation form, حَصَّلَ, while retaining the supplied Quranic passive occurrence.

senses.definition: To make manifest or bring to light what is hidden within.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic passive construction concerning what is in the breasts, the hidden contents are disclosed or made apparent.

senses.definition: To distinguish or discriminate what is contained within.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quran-attested interpretation of the passive construction concerning what is in the breasts; the contents are separated or made discernible.

senses.definition: To gather and collect what is contained within.
senses.usage_conditions: A Quran-attested interpretation of the same passive construction, including the idea that what is within is collected in registers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come forth, be produced, extracted, or brought out; to emerge or become apparent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a product brought out from a source, such as metal from ore, a kernel from its shell, or grain from straw, and more generally of something that comes out or presents itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exist or come into being; to become realized, prepared, ready, attained, or obtained.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A general Form I usage for the coming into existence or attainment of a thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To happen, occur, take place, or befall.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an event or incident.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To result, ensue, arise, proceed, supervene, or accrue; to be produced as a sum, product, or quotient.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an outcome or consequence, including the result of a calculation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To remain or continue after the rest has gone or passed away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of what persists from a reckoning, an action, or a similar process.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be established, fixed, binding, due, or obligatory.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction حَصَلَ لِي عَلَيْهِ may state that an amount or obligation became incumbent on someone to render as a debt.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To suffer from earth or pebbles eaten and retained inside the body.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of a horse, camel, or other beast when swallowed earth or pebbles remain internally and cause illness; also said of a boy when a stone is described as falling or remaining in the scrotum.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To extract, bring forth, or separate a product from its source.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transitive Form II counterpart of حَصَلَ; examples include extracting precious metal from ore, a kernel from its shell, or grain from straw.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring into being, realize, prepare, or make ready.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader transitive Form II usage not specifically established by the supplied Quran occurrence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To separate, discriminate, or distinguish what remains from what has passed away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used transitively when the remainder or surviving portion is sorted out from what is no longer present.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To perceive or apprehend a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form II usage distinct from producing or collecting it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attain, obtain, overtake, or acquire advantage, profit, or benefit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of reaching or securing a thing, and of gaining an advantage or profit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect and condense material; to reduce speech to its essential import, or for speech to comprise a matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of bringing the substance of a sentence or discourse together into its sum and substance, and of speech comprehending something within its scope.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of palms or dates, to put forth unripe or ripening dates; of dates, to emerge and become round; of a palm spadix, to become yellow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV botanical usage concerning the stages and appearance of palm produce.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become collected and remain or continue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V intransitive usage describing something that gathers and persists.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bird, to fill its crop or stomach.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A quadriliteral usage referring to filling the bird's حَوْصَلَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unripe or ripening dates, dates that have become hard and round, or the yellow spadix of a palm; also fresh green produce that has fallen and scattered from a palm.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical noun for stages or remnants of palm produce.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain plant.
The residue or discarded matter left from threshing or sifting grain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes what remains after the bulk of the grain has been removed, as well as inferior or rejected particles of barley and wheat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: What is produced, extracted, or made apparent; especially purified precious metal obtained from ore, and the yield or net produce of land or another source of revenue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal description of a product or yield, including what has been brought out or cleared from its source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Profit, advantage, gain, or acquisition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a benefit or gain secured from an action or transaction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The result, outcome, conclusion, end, issue, or ultimate effect of a thing; also the result of an arithmetical process.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes a sum, product, or quotient and, more generally, the consequence or outcome of an event or process.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The sum and substance or essential import of a sentence or discourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal usage for the condensed meaning comprehended by speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A remainder, remnant, residue, or surviving portion left after the rest has gone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of what remains from a thing, a reckoning, or an action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A depression or sheltered place where water rests in a meadow; also the far end of a watering-trough or tank where water remains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meadow sense is associated with herbage that is the last to dry up.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sheep or goat large in the part of the belly above the navel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of an animal's enlarged upper abdomen.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A certain plant.
The plant called بَاذَنْجَان, eggplant.
The stomach or crop of a bird; also the intestines of an animal with a cloven hoof or hoof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: For birds, the term may denote the crop specifically or the set of stomachs including the crop and gizzard; for certain animals it is used for the intestines.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figuratively, a storeroom or magazine, and a cell or compartment of a prison.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the bodily cavity or place in which things are gathered.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The lower part of the belly, extending to the pubes; the place where feces collect; or the region between the navel and pubes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a man or of an animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A baked-clay vessel resembling a حُقَّة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal usage, with the cited colloquial form noted in the lexical evidence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who clears or purifies silver or gold from ore.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine مُحَصِّلَةٌ denotes a woman who separates the mineral-bearing earth for extracting precious metal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Protuberant in the lower abdomen near the navel, as in a pregnant woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a pronounced lower-belly protuberance.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Same specialized palm-produce usage as the main unit.
Same water-resting-place meaning in a watering structure.
Illustrative phrase for the lower-belly meaning; it adds no separate lexical branch.

cautions: The single QAC occurrence is the passive Form II form حُصِّلَ at 100:10:1; the public headword is normalized to the active perfect citation form حَصَّلَ.
The senses “made manifest,” “distinguished,” and “collected” are distinct attested interpretations of the same Quranic construction, not separate Quran occurrences.
